description: The clients that called the server (Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, ChatGPT and others), each with its calls, error rate and response times, and its versions newest first: each version's calls, error rate, refused (calls whose arguments the schema refused), when it was first seen (isNew when within the window), and a verdict against the version of the same client before it (previous). The verdict counts only refused arguments, tool by tool, on the server versions both called (comparedOn), so a server release or outage in the same days is not blamed on the client: worse, same, better, too-early (no tool with 10 calls from each) or first. changedTools names the tools that decided it. olderCalls counts calls from versions past the ones named, unversionedCalls those from clients that gave no version.

days.description: How many days back to look, ending now. 7 when left out. Ignored when from is given.

from.description: Start of the window, as an ISO 8601 date or time. Overrides days.

server.description: The MCP server to ask about, by name or id. Leave out when the account has only one.

to.description: End of the window, as an ISO 8601 date or time. Now when left out.
